metadata.description: Personal cross-domain Agent Skills. One plugin per category; install only the categories a project or workspace needs.

plugins.name: superskills-creative
plugins.description: Image-generation direction, promo video planning and xTool F1 engraving design.

plugins.name: superskills-data
plugins.description: Data analysis and pre-share checks, metrics reviews, SQL query writing and chart design.

plugins.name: superskills-design
plugins.description: App Store / Play Store visual assets, UI design review and review of existing images.

plugins.name: superskills-development
plugins.description: Bug diagnosis, code review, technical design, implementation planning, technical debt triage, Godot 4.x (shared, 2D, 3D) and sprite animation pipelines.

plugins.name: superskills-ecommerce
plugins.description: Shopify theme, Liquid and store integration work, and inventory reorder decisions.

plugins.name: superskills-finance

plugins.name: superskills-legal

plugins.name: superskills-marketing

plugins.name: superskills-operations

plugins.name: superskills-people

plugins.name: superskills-personal

plugins.name: superskills-planning

plugins.name: superskills-product

plugins.name: superskills-research

plugins.name: superskills-sales
plugins.description: Sales call prep and recap, outreach, deal and pipeline reviews, quotes and bids.

plugins.name: superskills-support
plugins.description: Customer support triage, replies and escalations, help-center articles, review replies and win-back.

plugins.name: superskills-writing
plugins.description: Business email, store listing copy, marketing copy, brand voice guides, social content, interface microcopy and truthful resumes.
